title: Plea filed in Supreme Court to ensure 24x7 availability of courts to hear urgent life and liberty cases
description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday agreed to consider whether a protocol can be developed so that urgent cases involving imminent threats to rights to life and liberty are heard promptly, even beyond the regular working hours of courts [Maheravish Rein v. Union of India].A Bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant, Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana issued notice on a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) petition filed by Advocate Maheravish Rein on the issue.
